title: Manifest
description: Module manifest v1 (plan F006 §3.1, §3.4, §3.6, §6.1). Validated by createModule at start. Version and image digest are NOT here on purpose: they are derived from the signed image (§3.12), never self-reported.

id.description: Module id. Becomes the service name (svc:<id>).

permissions.description: Rights the module may use, <resource>:<action>. A call never gets more than both the user's role and this list allow (§3.4).

patientDataTables.description: Tables holding patient data. Reads of these are logged outside the module (§3.6).

egress.description: Host names the module may reach besides core (§6.1). Enforced by the network, not by the SDK.

required.description: Environment variables the module cannot start without (§3.10: missing value -> do not start, say which).
